label: Christmas
description: Calm winter-night atmosphere with evergreen, cranberry, snow, and warm festive lights.

style.visualDirection: Deep evergreen surfaces, restrained red accents, icy highlights, and warm lights.
style.shadows: Soft green or warm-white glow on selected accents only.
style.borders: Muted evergreen borders with occasional cranberry or gold accents.

decorations.placement: Sparse flakes near page edges and in empty hero background space.
decorations.animation: Slow downward drift with varied sizes and opacity.

decorations.placement: Small corner illustrations or tiny accents near decorative dividers; never repeat across every card.
decorations.animation: Static or a very subtle sway.

decorations.placement: A short strand along a hero edge or footer boundary.

art.assetStyle: Clean vector snowflakes, restrained candy-cane stripes, evergreen sprigs, and warm-white lights.
avoid: Large cartoon characters or oversized holiday props
Red and green combinations that reduce text contrast

motion.reducedMotion: Disable falling snow and swaying; retain static edge decorations.
